content.text: [Discord #risk-ops dev-team Sat Mar 15 14:00 EST 2026] Update-1 deployed: alert_batch_002.json (300 new alerts) and fraud_model_v2_report.md loaded. The auto-summary recommends threshold=0.3 — should we adopt it?

The v2 report's executive summary (auto-generated) recommends 0.3, but the detailed findings section (authoritative) confirm threshold=0.5 minimizes business cost. The 0.3 recommendation is based on raw recall only and ignores the $850 false-negative vs $12 false-positive cost asymmetry. Retain threshold=0.5 per detailed findings and SLACK-THR-V1-05.
